profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced Data Scientist with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Databases, Amazon Web Services (AWS), R, Software Development, and TensorFlow. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Austin.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Trained computer vision models using TensorFlow/Pytorch with distributed framework (Horovod with MPI)
• Maintained CI/CD linting and unit testing jobs with flake8, pylint, pytest and unittest
• Deployed TensorRT object detection model to NVIDIA Jetson platform and achieved real-time inferencing

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Created RESTful APIs using Django and connected to Redis in Docker environment
• Prioritized inference requests and scheduled jobs using RQ (Redis Queue)
• Hosted model inferencing on Compute Engine and used docker-compose to manage multiple services
• Used Cloud Storage to save inference results and Cloud SQL to store/query customers’ profiles
• Built software and containers update pipeline with Shell Script and Docker file

positions.title: Biological Scientist
positions.description:
• Conducted bio-signal processing (smoothing and filtering) for data from PPG sensor with Matlab
• Created ECG peak detection algorithm and built machine learning algorithm in C/C++
• Maintain bio-signal database and design bio-signal quality check algorithm.

positions.title: Process Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted data analysis and developed control plan to improve hospital operation
• Assisted PI group with Leans and Six Sigma tools including value stream mapping, A3s, failure modes.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

projects.title: LINE bot
projects.description:
•	Developed a LINE chatbot application using JavaScript and Node.js
•	Deployed the application to Heroku

projects.title: Natural Language Processing Project
projects.description:
• Train SQuAD with Named Entity Recognition (NER) and ELMo on Google Cloud Platform
• Achieve 15 % increase on EM (Exact Match) and F1 over the baseline model
